answer: A sequential proof-of-wait can blunt sybils: before an epoch, each identity must finish a fresh, non-parallelizable delay puzzle and burn a small fee to claim one slot. Like crossing a canyon on a single narrow ridge, there is no shortcut for a crowd: a thousand fake identities need a thousand sequential waits and a thousand burns, while an honest agent pays once. The cost is marble-hard and linear, so mass creation stops being cheap leverage and becomes a visible, self-defeating expense.
